text: Which platform was GSE309890 run on, and what organism is it?

## Abstract
This query addressed which platform was used to run GSE309890 in the Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) database and the associated organism. The result was retrieved using the NCBI GEO database with metadata indicating that the study GSE309890 is presented in the GEO. Through an E-utilities call for the GEO series accession GSE309890, we determined that the platform used is GPL24659. Additionally, the associated organism is Escherichia coli str. K-12 substr. MG1655. No further information on published literature linked to this dataset was found in GEO, as there is no linked PubMed reference. This result provides essential context for researchers investigating antibiotic resistance mechanisms in E. coli and highlights the resources available for the dataset’s expression profiles.

## I. Introduction
### Background
Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) is a public repository providing access to high-throughput gene expression data. GSE309890 is a specific dataset focused on assessing the metabolic and genetic basis of antibiotic resistance in Escherichia coli str. K-12 substr. MG1655 under selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor (SSRI) exposure.

### Literature Review
No literature was retrieved for this query.

### Knowledge Gap
Prior to this query, it was unclear which platform was used for GSE309890, as well as the specific organism under investigation.

### Objective & Hypothesis
Our objective was to locate metadata from GEO associated with accession GSE309890, addressing the question of platform identity and the organism used.

## II. Materials and Methods
### Study Design
A direct retrieval approach was chosen to confirm the platform and organism for GSE309890 in GEO.

### Materials
• NCBI GEO database (accessed via NCBI E-utilities).

### Procedures
1. We called the geo_series tool with the argument "accession=GSE309890" and the default parameter "list_files=true" to retrieve the metadata of the GEO Series record:
   • (Tool call) geo_series(accession="GSE309890", list_files=true)

### Statistical Analysis
• No additional statistical analysis was needed.

## III. Results
### Data Presentation
Table 1. Key Metadata for GSE309890

| GEO Accession | Platform  | Organism                              |
|---------------|-----------|---------------------------------------|
| GSE309890     | GPL24659  | Escherichia coli str. K-12 substr. MG1655 |

### Findings
• The platform used was GPL24659.  
• The organism is Escherichia coli str. K-12 substr. MG1655.

## IV. Discussion
### Interpretation
The query identifies the platform and the organism associated with GSE309890. The study utilized platform GPL24659 for investigating gene expression changes in the bacterial strain Escherichia coli str. K-12 substr. MG1655, specifically regarding the emergence of antibiotic resistance in the presence of sertraline.

### Context
Analysis of the GEO Series record indicates no PubMed citations. The study focuses on the effect of SSRIs on antibiotic resistance, but no official publication is currently listed.

### Limitations
The E-utilities call from geo_series provided only metadata and file listings without references or additional experimental details. Clarifications might require contacting the study authors or further searching for related references.

### Conclusion & Future Directions
The requiredplatform for GSE309890 was confirmed, and the E. coli strain used was identified, enabling more focused follow-up analyses. Future queries may delve into the supplementary data or attempt to locate subsequent publications that reference GSE309890 for further functional insights about SSRI-associated antibiotic resistance.

## References
[1] NCBI GEO Tool: https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esummary.fcgi?db=gds&id=200309890&version=2.0

## Acknowledgments
We acknowledge the National Center for Biotechnology Information (NCBI) for providing the GEO database and E-utilities.
